Definition: to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit
BiblicalUsage: 1) to domineer, exercise power over, dominate, have mastery, be master, lord it over; 1a) (Qal) to domineer, lord it over, become master; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to give power of; 1b2) to get mastery of
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
